correctness.rationale: For 0<epsilon<1 both eigenvalues are nonzero and off the unit circle. The exact spectral projectors satisfy Ps^2=Ps, Pu^2=Pu, PsPu=0, APs=aPs, APu=bPu. The absolutely convergent Green formula gives (K/epsilon,-1/epsilon) under an explicit norm-one forcing, and componentwise bounds give Shad <= (K+2)/epsilon. The resolvent denominator squared is concave in cos(theta), hence has minimum [epsilon(2-epsilon)]^2 at z=-1; triangle inequalities squeeze its maximal norm. These show the fixed-epsilon product limit 2-epsilon. For epsilon=1/4, K=8, rational arithmetic gives 56/39 > sqrt(2). The analytic arguments establish infinite-sequence and continuum claims; the separate script checks only finite algebra.
